body {
  do invoke collection.function_check(compare)
  let sorted = list.copy(xs)
  let out = []
  let n = list.len(sorted)
  let width = 1
  while num.lt(width, n) metered 2 {
    let start = 0
    while num.lt(start, n) metered 2 {
      let mid = num.add(start, width)
      if num.lt(n, mid) {
        set mid = n
      }
      let end = num.add(mid, width)
      if num.lt(n, end) {
        set end = n
      }
      let left = start
      let right = mid
      let dest = start
      while num.lt(left, mid) metered 2 {
        if num.lt(right, end) {} else {
          break
        }
        let before = sorted[left]
        let after = sorted[right]
        let order = apply compare(before, after)
        if eq(order, order) {} else {
          do invoke collection.unordered(order)
        }
        if num.lt(0, order) {
          set out[dest] = after
          set right = num.add(right, 1)
        } else {
          set out[dest] = before
          set left = num.add(left, 1)
        }
        set dest = num.add(dest, 1)
      }
      while num.lt(left, mid) metered 2 {
        set out[dest] = sorted[left]
        set left = num.add(left, 1)
        set dest = num.add(dest, 1)
      }
      while num.lt(right, end) metered 2 {
        set out[dest] = sorted[right]
        set right = num.add(right, 1)
        set dest = num.add(dest, 1)
      }
      set start = end
    }
    let previous = sorted
    set sorted = out
    set out = previous
    set width = num.add(width, width)
  }
  do invoke list.clear(xs)
  for value in sorted metered 2 {
    set xs[list.len(xs)] = value
  }
  return xs
}
